## Type of Change
<!-- Đánh dấu [x] vào loại change phù hợp -->

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎮 Game improvement (Chicken Shooter updates)
- [ ] 🔧 Configuration change
- [ ] 🚀 Performance improvement

## Checklist
<!-- Đánh dấu [x] những items đã hoàn thành -->

- [ ] Code follows project style
- [ ] Self-review completed
- [ ] Comments added for complex code
- [ ] Documentation updated (if needed)
- [ ] No new warnings generated
- [ ] Tested locally

### For Game Changes:
- [ ] Game builds successfully (`make`)
- [ ] Tested on emulator (`make test`)
- [ ] Tested on Tinker Board (if applicable)
- [ ] No gameplay-breaking bugs

### For Lakka/Scripts Changes:
- [ ] Tested on Tinker Board
- [ ] Scripts have proper permissions
- [ ] No breaking changes to existing workflows
